summary: Facepalm: Search capacity ran out partway through the scan. I found one candidate with two accepted sources: Wayne County, Mich., is reprinting absentee ballots for Belleville, Sumpter Township and Van Buren Township after a library board race error (FOX 2 Detroit, Sept 29; CBS Detroit, Sept 30). Both pages were opened and both quotes checked verbatim. Other stories in the window were set aside because I could only open one accepted source for each. Genius: Genius scan for 2026-09-30. Three candidates found, with every page opened and every quote checked against the fetched text. (1) SpaceX Starship reaches orbit for the first time on Flight 14 from Starbase, TX, on Sept 28. Sources are CBS News and TechCrunch. The Space.com-only problem from earlier runs is now fixed. (2) Texas State's Kate Spradley named a 2026 MacArthur Fellow, announced Sept 29, inside the window for this scan date. Sources are the AP list as republished by WSLS and the Texas State release. (3) UIUC's Kaiyu Guan named a 2026 MacArthur Fellow. Sources are the AP list via WSLS and the Illinois News Bureau. The search tool limit was hit partway through, so other leads (Space.com and ScienceDaily items from the window) could not be checked against a second source. Pair published.
